P7 upper hall (x120, z14..20, y6..8) is furnished as a 1-wide landing: a red_carpet runner down the lane, and two hanging lanterns at (120,8,15) and (120,8,19) via porchLantern. Feet-level lane stays clear, so no walk blocker is added.
make.sh exits 0 and writes a whole build.nbt; the hall line reads "7 placed" with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE.
In the real build the two lanterns are refused silently because nothing solid sits at y9 yet (roof skipped, shell-east still a stub), so the hall is not yet lit.
left: Lanterns refused in the real build: porchLantern needs a solid block at (120,9,z), and the roof (roof.json absent) and shell-east (stub) are not built here. The lamplighter check must be rerun once the roof lands; if y9 stays air, hang the lanterns from a ceiling block the roof or shell provides, or place standing lanterns on the carpet-free cells only where the walk allows.

The walk verdict and light cannot be checked here: the P7 floor (y5) and the partitions at x119/x121 come from shell-east, which is a stub in this copy. In a scratch build with a floor, partitions and a ceiling, light was 11..13 at every feet cell, 0 dark, and the carpet and lanterns rendered as intended; the 'no way in' verdict there is an artifact of the missing entry from the stair and neighbouring rooms.

No coat rack or focal piece: the hall is 1 cell wide and its doorways (x119, x121) belong to the neighbouring bedrooms, so any floor furniture would block a way in. The trade's coat rack (fence and banner) was left out for that reason; the focal read is the lantern pair and the runner. Revisit once the bedroom partitions and doorway cells are built.

waste.what: The plan's floor grid draws every unbuilt partition cell as 'D' doorway, so the 1-wide hall looks like a corridor of openings and the real doorways cannot be told apart from missing walls.
